title: Learning How to Learn
description: For school leavers who want to learn new skills faster and remember them for longer, whether in college, online courses or on the job. You will learn simple, well-tested study methods and build your own learning plan.
outcomes: Explain in simple terms how memory works and why we forget
Use active recall and spaced repetition to remember more
Beat procrastination with the Pomodoro technique and small habits
Take useful notes and learn effectively from online courses
Stay motivated and build a personal learning plan for a new skill
